title: Among molecules containing sulfur atoms involved in double bonds, determine
question: Among molecules containing sulfur atoms involved in double bonds, determine whether they are more likely to be carcinogenic or non-carcinogenic.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m."XCL_011" AS carcinogenic_flag, COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS molecule_count
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a."XCL_001" = c."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
WHERE a."XCL_003" = 's' AND b."XCL_006" = '='
GROUP BY m."XCL_011"
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC;

FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a."XCL_001" = c."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
WHERE a."XCL_003" = 's' AND b."XCL_006" = '='
GROUP BY m."XCL_011"
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC;

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT m."XCL_011" AS carcinogenic_flag, COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS molecule_count
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a."XCL_001" = c."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
WHERE a."XCL_003" = 's' AND b."XCL_006" = '='
GROUP BY m."XCL_011"
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC;
